text.exampleNote: This is an example site, held only on this page, so you can see a finished report. The real report reads Damage Control, Delay Analyzer, OEE, the Action Tracker and the other tools in this browser, and writes itself from what they hold.
text.exampleActions: The focus of the example is not added to your Action Tracker. Log your own work in the tools and the report writes yours.
text.nothing: None of the tools holds data for this period. Choose another period, or log the week in the tools first.

tips: The report has no data of its own: it reads what Damage Control, Delay Analyzer, OEE, the 5S Audit, the Action Tracker and the other tools hold in this browser.
Every number is set against the period before and against its target, in words as well as arrows, so the report reads the same on paper.
The site name and the targets come from the workplace profile, which the logs share. A target typed into a log wins over the profile.
The summary names the biggest risk and the one decision it needs; the focus lists the three things for next week. Send them to the Action Tracker with one tap.
Copy the text into an email, print it on A4, or download it as a Word file for the management meeting.
